precommitted_changes.staging: Existing Wyckoff 50/50 spring-test and later LPS add; same owner/campaign, no risk budget reset and no add after reduction, failure or pending exit
precommitted_changes.partial: Existing Harmonic Type-I/II source plan, fixed half of INITIAL quantity at TGT1; no half-of-remaining retry; final owned TGT2; cost-adjusted campaign breakeven next bar only
precommitted_changes.selector: Existing shared feasibility/FIFO/capacity/hash selector, no school-score comparison, no learned profitability claim
precommitted_changes.evidence: Source-bound event graph and frozen owner/mode, snapshot revalidation at entry, no expired/invalid parent or resurrection
precommitted_changes.profit_floor: No invented dollar or percent floor. Source-owned finite objective must cover explicit costs. This removes a requirement for a magic number, NOT proof of economically meaningful edge
precommitted_changes.quantity: Verify effective-dated PIT authority if actually supplied; numerical/prospective rules remain explicitly non-historical
precommitted_changes.negative_results: A failed qualification is a valid conclusion, never a PASS. Missing independent evidence remains OPEN, not renamed CLOSED

market_access: NONE until complete source/runtime/fidelity/quantity gate; no automatic replay to bypass failed authority
tests: Synthetic real-kernel accounting, owner/source/clock errors, capacity-delayed partial retries, partial-stop precedence, cost-adjusted breakeven, staged risk persistence, event graph atomicity, deterministic same-batch ordering
all_twelve_success_condition: Each original gap has its actual required source/implementation/independent verification. Explicit quarantine alone does not satisfy full closure.
